requirements.title: The left tab limit is established before data transfer and reset on record changes
requirements.definition: The left tab limit affects T and TL; before nonchild data transfer it is the current record or stream position, and after positioning to another record it becomes character position one of that record.

pending.left-tab-limit-initial-current-position: Internal WRITE starting at a fresh record: WRITE(buf,'("A",T1,"B")') expects exactly 'B', showing T1 is relative to the initial left tab limit.
pending.left-tab-limit-reset-new-record: WRITE(rec,'("A",/T2,"B")') to character(len=2) rec(2); expect rec(1)='A ' and rec(2)=' B', showing slash-created record resets the left tab limit to one.

requirements.title: Tn positions relative to the left tab limit in either direction
requirements.definition: Tn positions the next character at the nth character position of the record relative to the left tab limit, in either direction from the current position.

requirements.title: TLn positions backward but clamps at the left tab limit
requirements.definition: TLn positions n characters backward from the current position, except that if n exceeds the distance to the left tab limit, it positions at the left tab limit.
